page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro System. It features 64 virtual CPUs and 32 physical cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2048 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 32 GB per vCPU. Storage is supported by a 1900 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Passmark CPU scores placing in the top 25%. The instance also demonstrates strong performance in database operations and software compilation. Single-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks, including read and write operations on large blocks, fall within the average range.

Given the high density of memory relative to compute resources, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive in-memory datasets without needing proportional scaling of CPU cores. The combination of high-capacity DDR4 memory, local NVMe storage, and strong multi-core performance makes this instance suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
